announcements.headline: Award of RSUs and Grant of Options
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates the granting of equity-based incentives to staff, which is a standard administrative action related to employee retention and alignment. It does not suggest any immediate change in financial performance or corporate strategy.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement relates to director shareholdings, which typically indicates routine regulatory disclosure of insider transactions rather than a significant corporate event. announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments or statutory resolutions. It signifies standard corporate governance activity rather than any material change to the company's financial position or strategic direction.

announcements.headline: Half-Year Report

announcements.headline: Confirmation of Adelicious Acquisition Earn Out

Shareholders should consider the financial impact of this payment on the company's liquidity and net asset value.
